title: Se queda colgado
body: Tengo un iphone 17 y se queda totalmente colgado. Me hace la introducción en castellano y a continuación me sale la misma pantalla inicial en ingles y alli se queda
author: crissarresst

title: Dark patterns
body: Incredibly hard to cancel subscription. The Help Center is redirecting you a couple of times. When you finally arrive at a page where you are supposed to be able to manage your subscription there’s no button to do so. I reached out to support, fingers crossed they will react.

title: Scam charges
body: I have only signed up for a $1 trial and have cancelled it and forgot about the app recently. I have discovered I already had 3 charges of $39 every 3 months. What a scam! It's taking forever and they cannot locate my account.
author: Nick_bcn

title: Scam
body: I have a few days for a free trial and before that ended they charged twice 37 euros . I have emailed numerosi time and they have t done a thing and i don’t have my money back. Don’t download this app
author: Ama86x

title: Waste of time
body: They make you waste 20min answering questions before showing a paywall for 100 eur/month. It’s not even clear what the app will do
author: Saddducc

title: Idiomas.
body: Actualmente tengo descargada otra aplicación, ya que, esta solo está en inglés. Es una lástima por qué, me gustaría tener esta pero en inglés no es práctico para mi.
author: sekhmet.raa

title: It works
body: ADHD can be very personal but this is exactly what fits my needs. I'm amazed.
author: Marta - Mallorca

title: Por favor en español!!
body: La App me parece fabulosa pero está solo en inglés. Somos millones de personas los que hablamos otro idioma… en concreto el español. Les ruego contemplen la posibilidad, gracias!
author: pilarbuor
